title: Mike Vrabel wasn't bothered by Tom Brady's "no dog in the fight" remark before the Super Bowl

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Mike Vrabel wasn't bothered by Tom Brady's "no dog in the fight" remark before the Super Bowl
sources.description: Before Super Bowl LX between the Seahawks and the Patriots, New England legend Tom Brady rankled his former team's fans (and some current and former Patriots players), by declaring that he didn't have a "dog in the fight."
